flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.a: Declaration order, sequential 32-byte slots; sub-32-byte values pack right-aligned while they fit. Mappings/dynamic arrays reserve a bookkeeping slot; element k at keccak(abi.encode(k, slot)). Strings/bytes >31B store length*2+1 in head slot.

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.q: CALL vs DELEGATECALL - exact context differences?
flashcards.a: CALL: callee's storage frame, msg.sender rewritten to calling contract. DELEGATECALL: caller's storage + preserved msg.sender/value; only the code is foreign. STATICCALL adds read-only enforcement (Byzantium, Oct 2017).

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.q: Why is delegatecall both the proxy mechanism and the top hazard?
flashcards.a: Foreign code executes against YOUR storage with YOUR msg.sender/value - that's how proxies upgrade logic while keeping state, and how wallet-drainers work when users are tricked into delegatecalling attacker contracts.

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.q: Event gas cost formula vs storage write?
flashcards.a: LOG: 375 base + 375 per topic (max 3 + topic0 signature) + 8/byte; typical event ~1-1.5k gas vs 20000 fresh SSTORE. Bloom filter 2048-bit in block header aids search. Contracts CANNOT read events.

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.a: bytes4(keccak256('transfer(address,uint256)')) - first 4 bytes of keccak of canonical signature. Calldata = selector + 32-byte words, dynamic types via offsets. ERC-165 interface IDs = XOR of selectors.

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.a: keccak256('eip1967.proxy.implementation') - 1, hex prefix 0x360894a13ba1a... Pseudo-random so no declared variable collides. Same recipe for admin and beacon slots.

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.a: Transparent: proxy checks caller (admin sees upgrade fns), gas overhead every call. UUPS (EIP-1822): upgradeToAndCall lives IN implementation - minimal proxy, atomic upgrades, but bricking risk if impl breaks/burns.

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.a: July 2017: init() let anyone become owner of shared library; Nov 2017 suicide() killed it, freezing 513,000 ETH (~$150M then) permanently. Legacy: initializer modifiers, pre-initialized deployments, no shared mutable libraries.

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.q: Why don't constructors work through proxies? Replacement?
flashcards.a: Constructor code runs only during creation tx; proxy delegates to RUNTIME bytecode which has no constructor. Replacement: initialize() with initializer guard, reinitializer(n) for versioned migrations; disable initializers on standalone implementations.

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.q: ERC-7201 namespaced storage in one line?
flashcards.a: Module state root = keccak256(abi.encode(uint256(keccak256(id)) - 1)) & ~0xff... hashed namespaces that no linear declaration can collide with - EIP-1967 thinking generalized to app storage (adopted 2023).

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.q: CREATE2 address formula and two killer use cases?
flashcards.a: keccak(0xff ++ deployer ++ salt ++ keccak(initCode))[:20]. Counterfactual wallets (deploy-on-first-use at known address) and cross-chain same-address deployments. Footgun: salt front-running needs guards.

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.q: Solidity 0.8 arithmetic change and what remains dangerous?
flashcards.a: Overflow/underflow revert by default (SafeMath obsolete). Still bites: explicit unchecked blocks, narrowing casts (uint256->uint128 truncates silently), assembly-level ops, downstream integrations overflowing.

flashcards.topic: Solidity From Scratch: Storage, Calls, Events, Upgradeability
flashcards.a: Immutable unless expected logic iteration exceeds key-compromise risk. Upgradable requires credible governance: multisig + timelock (1-7 days) + monitoring. Immutables die with bugs; upgradables die with keys.
